description: Reverse lookup: which company holds this state or national register number? Give a company registration number (a Delaware file number, a British company number, a French SIREN, a Norwegian organisation number and so on) and get back the LEI records in GLEIF that carry it, each with its LEI, legal name, status, jurisdiction, registered address, the register that issued the number (id and name) and the number itself. Optionally narrow by registration_authority (GLEIF register id such as RA000602 for the Delaware Division of Corporations) or jurisdiction (US-DE, GB, DE). A number can exist in more than one register, so several hits come back as several labelled rows, never one guess; narrow with registration_authority or jurisdiction to pick one. Numbers are matched as published after removing invisible direction marks and surrounding spaces; leading zeros are never added or removed (00041424 and 41424 are different numbers), and some registers publish ids with internal spaces (the Norwegian register, "923 609 016"), so pass those with their spaces. Zero hits does NOT mean no such company: GLEIF only holds entities that obtained an LEI, so check company_register_search (company registers across countries) or sos_search (US state registers).

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction of the entity: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country ("GB") or ISO 3166-2 region ("US-DE").

registration_authority.description: Optional GLEIF registration authority id of the register that issued the number, "RA" + 6 digits, e.g. "RA000602" (Delaware), "RA000585" (United Kingdom). Bare digits are accepted.

registration_number.description: The company's own register number, e.g. "10084845" (Delaware file number) or "00041424" (United Kingdom).

name: gleif_find_by_registration_number

note.description: Coverage caveat: a miss means no LEI under this number, not that no such company exists

records.description: Matching LEI records; one row per LEI, labelled with its register

gleif_url.description: GLEIF search page for the record

legal_address.description: Registered address: lines, city, region, country, postal_code

registered_as.description: The number in the issuing register, whitespace removed

registration_authority_name.description: Register name from the GLEIF registration authorities list

registration_authority_website.description: Register website from the GLEIF list

registration_status.description: LEI registration status, e.g. ISSUED, LAPSED

registration_authority_filter.description: Register id filter applied, or null
